_comment: SAR red-flag register (the firm's internal reference, HAWKEYE STERLING APP note, 2 Oct 2026): indicators of suspicious ACTIVITY, AML/CFT/CPF, sanctions, trade-based ML, responsible sourcing, fraud, corruption and internal-conduct risk.

A red flag is an indicator requiring review, not evidence that an offence occurred. Detection does not equal guilt; clearance is not assumed while material information is missing, pending, inconsistent, unverifiable or unresolved.

detected_by: a txn_monitor rule code, or a control named in 'controls'. Any flag can be RECORDED on a task in the Transaction Monitoring section ('Red flags: SAR-CB-03'), on a payment or on an activity-only task.
A red flag does not automatically require an external SAR/STR: the decision follows the internal review, escalation and MLRO assessment (POL-19).

controls.payment_screening: Payment screening: every named party of a payment in the Transaction Monitoring section (and the payment reference) against the sanctions lists, plus FATF-listed jurisdictions and FATF R.16 completeness.
controls.screening: Daily customer screening: customers and their owners/UBOs against the sanctions lists, adverse media and PEP sources.
controls.kyc: PARTIAL - the daily screening reports R.10 CDD gaps (missing ID, nationality, date of birth, proof of address, expired documents) for the customers it flags, and shared owners/UBOs across the whole customer book.
controls.manual: Only a person can observe it: record the code on the payment or activity task (Red flags: ...).

categories.CM: Composite red flags requiring particular attention
